meaning:
αἱρετίζω,
[in LXX chiefly for בּחר (see Cremer, 615) ;] = αἱρέομαι (Hipp., Inscr.),
to choose: Mat.12:18 (LXX, ἀντιλήμψομαι).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
